ms_text:
One mark for each correctly completed line (Max 4)
 PROCEDURE Push(NewData : STRING)
     IF Top < Max – 1 THEN
        Top ← Top + 1
        StackArray[Top]  ← NewData
     ELSE
        OUTPUT "Stack full; new data cannot be added"
     ENDIF
 ENDPROCEDURE
